summary: SEH unwind handler (__userpurge, a1@ebx, eax result): calls RtlUnwind to a known landing pad (loc_58A359), clears the UNWIND bit (0x02) from ExceptionRecord->ExceptionFlags, then stores the current NtTib.ExceptionList into the caller's exception-registration pointer and returns it. Standard CRT-style SEH unwind-with-cleanup helper invoked by rendering dispatch paths.

operations.description: Invoke RtlUnwind with TargetFrame, landing pad loc_58A359, ExceptionRecord and NULL ExceptionFrame to unwind stack frames up to the target frame.
Clear the UNWIND bit: AND ExceptionRecord->ExceptionFlags with 0xFD (mask off bit 0x02) and store back.
Read the current NtTib.ExceptionList from the calling thread's TEB and store it into the caller-provided exception registration record pointer (a1, this:0x0), repointing the handler chain.
Return the updated exception-list pointer as the function result.
